name: A product team, with its lead drawn
description: The same operation as a-product-team, with its lead drawn as a person. Ada and the Operator talk in one chat app, mostly on a phone, and through private review pages that Ada marks or copies a prompt back from. Counts are for one morning.

people.name: Ada
people.role: Owns the operation. Talks to the Operator in one chat in the Claude app, mostly on their phone; marks its private pages; reads the morning notifications; carries prompts to the sessions it cannot reach

sessions.name: Operator
sessions.role: Plans; starts, steers and checks every session on account B; merges; keeps the review pages. Extra-high effort. Leads the research project too
sessions.repo: 4 repositories: the product's, the research project's and two of Ada's sites

sessions.name: Build lanes
sessions.role: Each builds one piece of the product on its own branch. Opus 5.5 now; Sonnet 5.5 for lighter work (none running)

sessions.name: Integrators
sessions.role: Run the full test suite on main plus the PRs named, and report each failure with its lead

sessions.name: One-off helpers
sessions.role: Short jobs the Operator starts when the pace allows: an audit, a catalog (two on September 30, none running now)

sessions.name: Digest and patrol
sessions.role: Read-only: a fresh session each morning reads the state (or tests the live site) and reports to Ada's phone

sessions.name: Research lanes
sessions.role: A private research project, worked in its own lanes; the Operator is their lead

sessions.name: Diagram session
sessions.role: Builds the diagram tool: exports, operation maps and the live view. High effort

sessions.name: Codex
sessions.role: Outside checks for the research project: a prior-art review and a claim spot-check so far

handoffs.what: what Ada wants done, in their own words or a file they attach; their usage numbers; answers they copy back from a decision page's pre-filled prompt; and anything a routine's notification or another session told them
replies in the chat: reports, questions for Ada, step-by-step instructions, and the prompts it writes for the sessions it cannot reach; pictures and backups come as files in the chat
decision pages with calls and a pre-filled prompt Ada copies back; boards Ada marks
a new lane: create_session (Claude Code Remote tools) with the brief as its first prompt, its model and its branch
each later message: a new round, a failure to fix, merge main, Ada's marks
one draft PR per round, plus a report file on the branch; the Operator reads the lane's last message and status with get_session, not its transcript

carrier.where: private review pages on account B

handoffs.what: a preview of each changed piece; Ada marks each good or fix, and the Operator and the lane read the marks
